title: SERMO - Corpus de sermons protestants 1550-1750
notes: SERMO is an SNSF project (2015-2018) at Neuchatel that produced an annotated corpus of 62 French Protestant sermons (~600k tokens, mostly printed in Geneva, by Calvin, Beze, Daille, Mestrezat, the Turrettini etc.), with tokenisation, lemmatisation and POS annotation for diachronic French linguistics. The XML corpus version 1 was released on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14620210, CC BY 4.0); the project site (sermo.unine.ch) is live but the project itself closed in 2018. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: Universite de Neuchatel (Carine Skupien Dekens; SNSF grant 105212_160030)
